aliases: 2M AHD 아날로그 IR 하우징 카메라 (2MP AHD analog IR housing camera)
features: 2MP AHD analog camera integrated in an IR housing
Day & Night (ICR), WDR 120dB, BLC/HLC, SSNR IV, defog
Motion detection (4 zones), privacy masking (8 zones)
Coax control: ACP (AHD), TCP (TVI), CCP (CVI), Pelco-C (CVBS)
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision datasheet (DataSheet_HCB-2020RH_220321_KO.pdf, Korean-language; values translated). Listed on the Korean Hanwha Vision site only, hence markets kr. B/W min. illumination is stated only as 0 Lux (IR LED on), so it is not recorded.
